skill.name: github-project-contributor-finder-api-skill
skill.description: Find GitHub repositories and public contributor profile details through the BrowserAct API. Use keyword, star count, update date, page, and item limits to shape the search.
skill.summary: Find GitHub repositories and public contributor contacts with BrowserAct.
skill.author: browser-act

security_audit.summary: Confirmed findings are limited to intended BrowserAct network calls, environment access to BROWSERACT_API_KEY, and one documented Python command invocation. Most high secret-key and backtick findings are false positives from variable names or Markdown formatting, but the skill still has credential-handling and contributor privacy risks.

remediation.issue: API key handling guidance asks users to provide secrets.
remediation.suggestion: Require BROWSERACT_API_KEY to be set locally and remove wording that asks users to paste or provide API keys in chat.

remediation.issue: Contributor contact data is collected for outreach and lead generation.
remediation.suggestion: Add consent, privacy, platform-policy, and lawful-use guidance before collecting or using contributor contact details.

remediation.issue: The skill instructs agents to execute a shell command with user-controlled parameters.
remediation.suggestion: Document argument-array execution or strict quoting for user inputs, and validate numeric parameters before invocation.

remediation.issue: The script sends searches and API credentials to BrowserAct endpoints.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the BrowserAct network dependency and require user confirmation before sending sensitive search context.

content.user_title: Find GitHub Contributors and Repository Leads
content.value_statement: Finding active GitHub projects and contributor contacts takes repetitive search work. This skill queries BrowserAct to return repository metrics and public contributor profile details.
actual_capabilities: Searches GitHub repositories by keyword, minimum stars, and updated date.
Runs a BrowserAct workflow through a local Python script.
Polls task status until the hosted workflow finishes or times out.
Returns repository names, URLs, owners, descriptions, and star counts.
Returns public contributor profiles, bios, websites, and Twitter handles.
Reports common BrowserAct authorization and concurrency errors.
limitations: Requires a valid BROWSERACT_API_KEY before the script can run.
Sends search parameters and task requests to BrowserAct.
Results depend on BrowserAct availability and GitHub page visibility.
Does not verify contributor consent for recruiting or marketing outreach.

use_cases.title: Source Open-Source Candidates
use_cases.description: Find active contributors in a specific technical area and review their public GitHub profile details.

use_cases.title: Map Developer Communities
use_cases.description: Identify recently updated repositories and contributor profiles for community programs or partnership research.

use_cases.title: Research Repository Markets
use_cases.description: Collect repository metrics and descriptions to compare project activity in a software category.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Repository Search
prompt_templates.prompt: Find GitHub repositories about browser automation with at least 100 stars.

prompt_templates.title: Recent Project Discovery
prompt_templates.prompt: Find React framework repositories with at least 1000 stars updated after 2026-01-01. Return five projects.

prompt_templates.title: Contributor Outreach List
prompt_templates.prompt: Find machine learning repositories updated after 2025-06-01. Include public contributor websites and Twitter handles when available.

prompt_templates.title: Competitive Ecosystem Scan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced market research across more results.
prompt_templates.prompt: Search two pages of browser automation repositories with at least 500 stars. Summarize owners, contributors, and project positioning.

output_examples.input: Find browser automation repositories with at least 100 stars.
output_examples.output: A list of matching repositories with names, owners, URLs, descriptions, star counts, and public contributor profile details.

output_examples.input: Find React framework projects updated after 2026-01-01.
output_examples.output: Recent matching repositories, each paired with contributor bios, profile links, personal websites, and Twitter handles when present.

output_examples.input: Map contributors for machine learning repositories with 1000 or more stars.
output_examples.output: A research-ready summary of active projects and public contributor profiles for recruiting or partnership review.

best_practices: Set BROWSERACT_API_KEY in the local environment before running the skill.
Use narrow keywords and reasonable page limits to reduce unnecessary data collection.
Review outreach and privacy obligations before using contributor contact details.
anti_patterns: Do not paste API keys into chat or commit them to files.
Do not use broad searches to harvest large contact lists without a lawful purpose.
Do not retry authorization or concurrency failures automatically.

faq.question: What service does this skill use?
faq.answer: It uses the BrowserAct GitHub Project and Contributor Finder workflow through a Python script.

faq.question: Does it require an API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The script reads BROWSERACT_API_KEY from the local environment.

faq.question: What GitHub data can it return?
faq.answer: It can return repository metadata and public contributor profile fields documented by the workflow.

faq.question: Can it search by repository activity?
faq.answer: Yes. The updated parameter filters repositories by last update date.

faq.question: Does it run local browser automation?
faq.answer: No local browser automation is shown. The script calls BrowserAct hosted workflow endpoints.

faq.question: Is it suitable for marketing outreach?
faq.answer: Use it only with consent, legal review, and platform policy compliance.
